subject: OrbitDevs MAP & acceptance lane for cloud private offer (AWS/GCP billing path)
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@orbitdevs.com>; Kenji Sakamoto <kenji.s@orbitdevs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: OrbitDevs MAP & acceptance lane for cloud private offer (AWS/GCP billing path)

Hi Lara / Kenji —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our chat, attached is the first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that maps the evaluation milestones, procurement checkpoints, and the billing route we recommend for a Marketplace private offer (AWS or GCP). Key context up front: OrbitDevs prefers vendor invoices to route via AWS Marketplace private offers where possible, with Net30 invoicing to your AP team.

High-level ask: please confirm the internal approvers and any fixed procurement blackout dates so we can align milestone dates.

Highlights in the attached draft (redwood-mpa-draft-20280720.pdf):
- 2-week POC window (team access + 50k tokens/day)
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 checklist due (we can pre-fill common answers) — target 10 business days
- Private Offer creation & review (AWS & GCP options) — legal/finance review and docuSign signature
- Billing: prefer Marketplace private offer -> AWS invoices charged to OrbitDevs account; alternative: Redwood invoice to OrbitDevs (requires additional PO)

Proposed milestone dates (tentative):
1) POC kickoff: 2028-07-27
2) Security checklist complete: 2028-08-10
3) Private Offer in draft (cloud vendor): 2028-08-14
4) Contract & PO submission: 2028-08-21
5) Go-live / billing activation: 2028-09-01

Next steps for us internally: Grace will coordinate the AWS private-offer flow with our marketplace ops; Karthik will validate pricing tiers for the private SKU.

Attaching the MAP + a short private-offer T&Cs doc (aws-private-offer-tnc-20280721.docx) for legal review.

Thanks — looking forward to your input.

Best,
Mateo
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
(650) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-mpa-draft-20280720.pdf (MAP draft)
Attachment: aws-private-offer-tnc-20280721.docx (terms template)
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@orbitdevs.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kenji Sakamoto <kenji.s@orbitdevs.com>, procurement@orbitdevs.com
Date: 2028-07-21T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OrbitDevs MAP & acceptance lane for cloud private offer (AWS/GCP billing path)

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the clear MAP. A few quick notes from procurement and legal:
- Procurement wants the Marketplace private offer route on AWS if Redwood can guarantee the invoice will flow through AWS Marketplace billing (our finance prefers this for tracking).
- We have a scheduled month-end freeze 08/15–08/20 for internal system updates — we will not approve new POs in that window. Could you avoid scheduling a contract signature during those dates?
- Security: we run your SOC2 attestation through our security tooling; if you can provide the SOC2 report and a short evidence bundle (data retention, audit log location), that will speed review.

On the POC: 2-week window is good. Can you confirm a service account will be provisioned with API key rotation guidelines? Also provide a short eval script we can run to validate latency/cost per 1k tokens.

We will loop in our Finance lead (procurement@orbitdevs.com) — copied — to confirm Net30 and PO conventions.

Lara Chen
Head of Product, OrbitDevs
lara.chen@orbitdevs.com

---
Attachment: none
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@orbitdevs.com>; Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OrbitDevs MAP & acceptance lane for cloud private offer (AWS/GCP billing path)

Thanks Lara — we can accommodate the 08/15–08/20 freeze and will shift the signature target accordingly. Quick answers:
- SOC2: sending a secure share this afternoon with the latest SOC2 Type II report and an evidence zip (redactions for customer names included).
- Private Offer billing: Mateo and I will test the AWS marketplace private-offer creation in our staging account and confirm invoice routing. If AWS Marketplace routing is not feasible for a specific SKU, we will provide an alternative Redwood invoicing workflow with invoice + PO templates.
- Service accounts: yes, we will provision a temporary scoped service account for the POC with API key rotation and a 30-day token expiry. Mateo, can you attach the short eval script and the cost-per-1k-token table?

Karthik: can you price the private SKU options (base plus committed usage discount) and confirm any minimum monthlys? We want to feed that into the MAP before the next update to OrbitDevs.

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>; Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-22T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OrbitDevs MAP & acceptance lane for cloud private offer (AWS/GCP billing path)

Quick pricing notes for the MAP update:
- Private SKU (small) — list: $0.006 / 1k tokens; committed 3-month: $0.0048 / 1k tokens (min 50k tokens/day)
- Private SKU (medium) — list: $0.005 / 1k tokens; committed 6-month: $0.004 / 1k tokens (min 200k tokens/day)
- No setup fee for Marketplace private offer; one-time legal review only.

I will attach a short price appendix and mark the MAP with the commitment windows. Also confirming we can push go-live to 2028-09-05 to avoid your 08/15–08/20 freeze and give legal time for DocuSign routing.

—Karthik
Head of Pricing | Redwood Inference

Attachment: price-appendix-orbitdevs-20280722.xlsx (referenced)
From: Kenji Sakamoto <kenji.s@orbitdevs.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>; Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara.chen@orbitdevs.com>, procurement@orbitdevs.com
Date: 2028-07-24T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OrbitDevs MAP & acceptance lane for cloud private offer (AWS/GCP billing path)

Mateo / Grace —

Appreciate the updates. Procurement confirms Net30 via AWS Marketplace private offer is preferred and Finance will accept AWS invoices if the private offer is bound to our master account. We are good to proceed with the revised MAP and the 2028-09-05 go-live target.

Action items I will own on our side:
- Finalize internal approvers list by 2028-07-28 (CFO + Cloud Ops)
- Send PO template once legal approves the private-offer T&Cs
- Validate account numbers for AWS Marketplace binding (I will send those by 2028-07-26)

Please send the updated MAP (with pricing appendix included) and the DocuSign envelope when ready. Also, Kenji — please confirm in the thread when you upload the PO template so we can link to the DocuSign room.

Kenji Sakamoto
Director, IT Procurement | OrbitDevs
kenji.s@orbitdevs.com
